name: LeetSwap V2 pair public fee-transfer drain
summary: LeetSwapV2Pair declared its fee-transfer helper _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens(token, amount) public, so anyone could move any amount of a pair's reserve token into its fees contract. After sync() the reserve collapsed and a tiny swap drained the other side; the moved tokens stay locked in the fees contract, outside the fee index.

campaign.selection: Drains of LeetSwap factory pairs through the public _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens, by senders other than the factory owner 0xd40846a1 and the rescuers 0xba8fa7a2 and 0x0d1b7532 (trace scan of all factory pairs).

notes: One incident across the factory's pairs: a trace scan of all its pairs from factory creation finds this as the first external call of the helper. Only this pair ran in the anchor; the other drained pairs (incl. the former per-pair records) are campaign.

Excluded as rescues (rule 5): drains by the factory owner 0xd40846a1 and by 0xba8fa7a2/0x0d1b7532, which paid about 302 ETH to 58 LeetSwap LPs. Priced reserve tokens moved into fees contracts are locked and counted; unpriced memecoin sides are valued at 0.

Loss is each pair's net reserve-token outflow per tx (loss.mjs semantics); loss.mjs reproduces the attacker's 12 txs within 0.01%. Scan ends at block 3,499,999; all pairs together then held about 23 WETH.
